findings.detail: The issuer_name field leaked sector, instrument type, reference/spread, interest-rate, and maturity text; the source issuer cell is only USW Holdings, LLC.

rationale: The raw SOI row keeps issuer, type, reference rate/spread, interest rate, maturity, par amount, cost, and fair value in separate columns. The stored issuer_name concatenates the sector label and multiple non-issuer columns into the issuer field, so the C206 parse-leak flag is a real localized extraction error.
